answer: The hot water comes from an electric geyser. You need to switch it on about 30 minutes before you need hot water. It automatically turns off after 2 hours. Please wait 30 minutes after turning it on again if you need more hot water.

args.query: How does the hot water system work in apartment? Is there a specific procedure to ensure the shower provides hot water consistently?

[{"source_id":"7.3","title":"Hot water (geyser)","text":"House manual > 7. Cooling, Heating, Hot Water and Drinking Water > 7.3 Hot water (geyser)

Hot water comes from an electric geyser (storage water heater). The switch is on the wall outside the bathroom door. **Switch it on about 30 minutes before you need hot water.** A timer automatically cuts the power after 2 hours, so switch it on again if you need more. Geyser sizes: Studio 35 litres, One-Bedroom 50 litres, Two-Bedroom 80 litres, Penthouse two 80-litre units. After heavy use, allow about 30 minutes for reheating. We use electric geysers because piped gas pressure in Lahore can be low, especially on winter mornings."},{"source_id":"7.5","title":"Drinking water","text":"House manual > 7. Cooling, Heating, Hot Water and Drinking Water > 7.5 Drinking water

**Do not drink the tap water.** Every kitchen has a filtered (reverse osmosis, RO) water dispenser with hot and cold water, and two bottled waters are waiting on arrival. Please use the filtered water for drinking, tea and cooking rice or pasta."},{"source_id":"7.4","title":"Water supply","text":"House manual > 7. Cooling, Heating, Hot Water and Drinking Water > 7.4 Water supply

Water comes from a rooftop tank and an automatic booster pump, available 24 hours. Occasionally the building cleans the tank; we announce it at least a day ahead."},{"source_id":"13.3","title":"Quick fixes","text":"House manual > 13. Maintenance and Troubleshooting > 13.3 Quick fixes

| Problem | What to try |
|---|---|
| No power in the apartment | Check the breaker board in the entrance closet (section 6.3). If the whole building is dark, wait for the generator (about 30 seconds). |
| AC not cooling | Check the mode is **Cool**, the temperature is 24 to 26 °C, windows are closed, and the remote batteries are fresh. During a power cut only the green-sticker AC works. |
| No hot water | Check the geyser switch outside the bathroom is on, and wait 30 minutes. The geyser does not work on the generator and its 2-hour timer may have switched it off. |
| Weak gas flame | Common on winter mornings. Use the induction plate. |
| Low water pressure | The booster pump is automatic. Wait 10 minutes, then message the host. |
| Wi-Fi not working | Unplug the router for 30 seconds (section 5.1). The 4G backup starts automatically. |
| TV remote not working | Replace the batteries from the TV-stand drawer. |
| Door keypad not responding | Touch the keypad to wake it and enter the code followed by **#**. If it still does not respond, call the emergency maintenance line. |"}]
